title: Exercise 8: Sentence Building from Cues
instruction: Use the given cue words to write complete, grammatically correct sentences using the Past Simple and Past Continuous.

questions.cues: While / Dr. Dang Thuy Tram / work / field hospital / she / write / inspiring diary
questions.correct_answer: While Dr. Dang Thuy Tram was working in the field hospital, she wrote an inspiring diary.
acceptable_answers: While Dr. Dang Thuy Tram was working in the field hospital, she wrote an inspiring diary.
While Dr. Dang Thuy Tram was working in a field hospital, she wrote an inspiring diary.
questions.explanation: Thêm mạo từ và giới từ, chia 'was working' (hành động kéo dài sau While) và 'wrote' (Quá khứ đơn).

questions.cues: Steve Jobs / design / first Macintosh / when / he / encounter / critical technical issues
questions.correct_answer: Steve Jobs was designing the first Macintosh when he encountered critical technical issues.
acceptable_answers: Steve Jobs was designing the first Macintosh when he encountered critical technical issues.
questions.explanation: Chia 'was designing' cho hành động đang diễn tiến và 'encountered' cho sự cố phát sinh bất ngờ sau 'when'.

questions.cues: While / animator / sketch / new characters / director / review / screenplay
questions.correct_answer: While the animator was sketching new characters, the director was reviewing the screenplay.
acceptable_answers: While the animator was sketching new characters, the director was reviewing the screenplay.
questions.explanation: Hai hành động song song trong quá khứ: cả hai vế đều chia Quá khứ tiếp diễn ('was sketching' và 'was reviewing').

questions.cues: General Vo Nguyen Giap / lead / soldiers / victory / while / country / fight / independence
questions.correct_answer: General Vo Nguyen Giap led his soldiers to victory while the country was fighting for independence.
acceptable_answers: General Vo Nguyen Giap led his soldiers to victory while the country was fighting for independence.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính dùng Quá khứ đơn 'led', mệnh đề phụ sau 'while' dùng Quá khứ tiếp diễn 'was fighting'.

questions.cues: When / surgeon / receive / prestigious award / she / feel / cloud nine
questions.correct_answer: When the surgeon received the prestigious award, she felt on cloud nine.
acceptable_answers: When the surgeon received the prestigious award, she felt on cloud nine.
questions.explanation: Cả hai hành động diễn ra liên tiếp dứt khoát: nhận giải ('received') và cảm xúc hạnh phúc ('felt on cloud nine').

questions.cues: The young innovator / drop out / university / while / he / develop / cutting-edge software
questions.correct_answer: The young innovator dropped out of university while he was developing cutting-edge software.
acceptable_answers: The young innovator dropped out of university while he was developing cutting-edge software.
questions.explanation: Hành động thôi học 'dropped out' diễn ra trong giai đoạn đang phát triển phần mềm 'was developing'.

questions.cues: While / resistance forces / defend / valley / enemy / launch / surprise attack
questions.correct_answer: While the resistance forces were defending the valley, the enemy launched a surprise attack.
acceptable_answers: While the resistance forces were defending the valley, the enemy launched a surprise attack.
questions.explanation: Cuộc tấn công bất ngờ ('launched') cắt ngang quá trình phòng thủ thung lũng ('were defending').

questions.cues: What / researchers / investigate / when / fire / break out / laboratory?
questions.correct_answer: What were the researchers investigating when the fire broke out in the laboratory?
acceptable_answers: What were the researchers investigating when the fire broke out in the laboratory?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi ở thì Quá khứ tiếp diễn 'were the researchers investigating' kết hợp với sự cố hỏa hoạn 'broke out'.

questions.cues: During his youth / Alexander / attend school / diligently / before / he / attend college
questions.correct_answer: During his youth, Alexander attended school diligently before he chose to attend college.
acceptable_answers: During his youth, Alexander attended school diligently before he chose to attend college.
During his youth, Alexander attended school diligently before he attended college.
questions.explanation: Sự kiện diễn ra trong thời niên thiếu đã hoàn thành trong quá khứ dùng Quá khứ đơn 'attended school' và 'attend college'.

questions.cues: While / historians / translate / ancient manuscripts / they / uncover / rare royal records
questions.correct_answer: While the historians were translating ancient manuscripts, they uncovered rare royal records.
acceptable_answers: While the historians were translating ancient manuscripts, they uncovered rare royal records.
questions.explanation: Hành động phát hiện ghi chép quý hiếm ('uncovered') diễn ra trong quá trình dịch thuật ('were translating').
